body:
The night started like any other friday night. I had a hockey game and I was hanging around one of my metalhead friends who likes getting high as much as I do. My past experiments include Pot, DXM, Diphenhydramine and MDMA.
I arrived around 630, and my friends said, 'Hey man, I got something for you!' I responded 'Lets see it'. In his hand I see a little Orange Pill with a Transformer (autobot) face. The little orange triple stack called to me, and with a swig of Arizona Green tea, I popped it.
For the first hour I didn't feel anything but a bit of energy. I went about my normal ways talking with friends. About an hour and a half later I realized that I was feeling something, and then I KNEW there was something.
About an hour and a half later I realized that I was feeling something, and then I KNEW there was something.
My emotions were completely positive, and my conversations were alive and very empathetic, I felt at peace with everything, even the fact that our scorer for my team was absent and I knew the game would be a slaughter. For the next 2 hours I felt energized, happy and friendly with everyone, even though one of my friends had eaten all of my delicious candy. The jokes and laughter were abundant, and everything was great. I went to the bathroom to make sure I was actually high, and sure enough, I looked into a mirror and eyes with a thin line of green stared back at me, I started to smile and I went back outside.
It was time for the game, amped up, but ready for the loss I get out on the ice.
When the final buzzer goes off, the score is 10-4. Not caring that we lost I skate over to our new goalie, and give him a man hug. He did amazing for his first time. Our team goes out for a brief of the game. After a talk, we all agree that it was a fantastic game, though lost.
The ride home is nice, I have energy but not too much, and the colors are nice and amplified. I get home and lay in bed. I feel the effects going away, but I want so badly for them to stay
I feel the effects going away, but I want so badly for them to stay
, but drift off into sleep around 130 in the morning.
I woke up about 11 the next day, feeling tired and a bit depressed, but I was expecting this. The day was fairly apathy filled, not much to make me feel good or bad. It is now 2 days after, and I still feel lingering apathy, but nothing bad.
Overall, great experience, and being prepared for the days after, the after effects aren't too bad. This is something I plan to do again, but I am a bit uneasy about how badly I want to repeat the experience.
